subject: Link-only guideline rows in sources.yaml (ACC/AHA, ESC, GOLD, GINA, ATS, IDSA, CHEST)
body:
S23-B (cardio-resp) needs link-only guideline rows in config/sources.yaml for `furtherReading` and item `references`. Today the only guideline-ish rows are cdc-guidelines, uspstf and ahrq, so ACC/AHA, GOLD, GINA etc. cannot be cited and the validator rejects unknown sourceIds.

Proposal (all link-only: allow_copy false, allow_modify false, allow_ai_ingest false, tier 1; we restate recommendations in our own words):

| id | name | url |
|---|---|---|
| acc-aha-guidelines | ACC/AHA clinical practice guidelines | https://www.acc.org/guidelines |
| esc-guidelines | ESC clinical practice guidelines | https://www.escardio.org/Guidelines |
| gold-copd | GOLD COPD report | https://goldcopd.org/ |
| gina-asthma | GINA asthma strategy | https://ginasthma.org/ |
| ats-guidelines | American Thoracic Society guidelines | https://www.thoracic.org/statements/ |
| idsa-guidelines | IDSA practice guidelines | https://www.idsociety.org/practice-guideline/ |
| chest-guidelines | CHEST guidelines | https://www.chestnet.org/guidelines-and-topic-collections |

Other authors will need similar rows (ADA, KDIGO, ACOG, AAP...), so one shared edit by you is better than seven. Q: will you add these (or tell me to add them under a claim on config/sources.yaml)? Until then I cite statpearls links only and add guideline links in a follow-up batch.
